lines.text: Somewhere on your laptop there's a CV final, a CV final two, and a CV final, really final. None of them is quite up to date.
And the online builders? You fill in every field, pick a design, press download, and only then does it ask for an account, or a card.
Your career is one story. Keep it in one place, and make the CV each job needs from it.
That place is CV Generator. Every role, project and skill, in one structured record. Bring it in from your LinkedIn export, or type it once.
It's your real history, and you keep it. It doesn't need embellishing: it's already true. It only needs the right emphasis for each role.
Paste the job you want. The AI works only from your record, and it's told never to invent a title, a skill or a number. It picks what matters for that role, and rewrites the emphasis.
Nothing changes until you've read it. Apply it when it's right, and adjust any line by hand. If it went a step too far, take it out.
Every version is kept, so you can always go back.
How it looks is a separate choice. Eighteen templates, fourteen palettes, four layouts, and the content never moves.
And when it's done, the download is just a download. A PDF, exactly as you see it, page breaks and all.
Export your record as JSON and import it whenever you want, in another browser or on another computer. It stays yours.
There's no account to create. Your record lives in your browser, and if you run it yourself, the AI can be a model on your own machine.
CV Generator. Stop duplicating, start generating. The app is free, and so is the code. cvbuilder dot destbreso dot com.
